text:
marc: Heads-up: official marketplace listing goes live next Tue APAC window. We need a tight runbook for press/blog/landing+SI tiles. Can owners call dibs?

anita: I'll own press and blog. Deliverable: press release (final draft), short blog, and media one-pager. Drafts in docs: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace/apac-draft. Need partner quotes for 2 SI vendors.

jorge: I'll own microsite swap and marketplace tiles. Need final asset pack from HW partners (png/svg) and confirmation of allowed use. Also need to know if we should show SI integrations badges on mobile.

priya: I'll coordinate SI integration messaging + onboarding docs. We should include quickstart snippets for Partner X and Partner Y. Also ensure SDK links point to GA vs beta.

build-bot: Note: automated cutover job 'marketplace-cutover' scheduled. Job ID: mc-2026-05-14-02. It performs: CDN invalidation -> feature flag flip -> redirect update. Dry-run allowed.

marc: Timings proposal: embargo lift 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET => that's 01:00 SGT next day. Blog at 01:10 SGT, microsite swap at 01:20 SGT, partner email at 01:30 SGT. Is that spacing ok?

anita: Prefer embargo lift 20 minutes before blog so APAC press has time. Suggest lift 00:50 SGT, blog 01:10 SGT, swap 01:20 SGT, partner email 01:30 SGT.

jorge: Sequence sounds good. Reminder: edge cache TTL currently 10m for partner tiles. We'll set Cache-Control: no-cache on the swap and run a purge after cutover.

priya: For SI badges: partner legal approved badges for "Marketplace Integrations" page but not for home hero. We'll add them to integration details pages only.

marc: Legal signoff status?

legal-bot: Partner legal approvals: SI-A: approved (signed_2026-05-03). HW-B: pending (asset#HW-B21) - requested update 2026-05-04. No embargo issues flagged.

anita: Can we get a contact for HW-B legal? I have a call scheduled at 08:00 PT. If not signed by EOD APAC, we hide their tile and show "Coming soon".

jorge: I'll add the "Coming soon" placeholder template to the design system so swap is trivial.

build-bot: Pre-cutover smoke checks: 1) GET /marketplace -> 200 + hero shows listing 2) GET /partner/{id} -> 200 + logo 3) CDN purge complete -> no old assets. Runbook in ops repo: git.sha=abc123.

marc: Rollback plan? Simple flag off, and CDN re-directs back. Jorge, can you script the flag rollback?

jorge: Yup. Quick curl rollback: curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.com/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"marketplace_live","state":"off"}'
I'll include health-check gating scripts.

priya: Also verify telemetry for partner acquisition funnel (utm_campaign=marketplace_apac, utm_source=partner). Growth will want token-level cost delta too.

anita: I'll bake UTMs into the press release and blog templates. Also add canonical link to partner pages to avoid duplicate content.

marc: Who's monitoring on-call during cutover?

build-bot: On-call rota: eng-oncall: jessica (primary), ram (secondary). Pager rules active during maintenance windows.

marc: OK owners: marc (overall), anita (press/blog), jorge (microsite/cutover+rollback), priya (SI messaging & docs). Action items: 1) legal followups (anita) 2) HW assets final (jorge) 3) UTMs + media list (anita) 4) cutover dry-run (jorge + build-bot) 5) SI quickstarts (priya). Reply when done.

anita: Press kit updated with partner quotes + UTMs. Shared with media list.

jorge: Ran dry-run at staging - minor CSS tweak found, fixed. Final dry-run scheduled 30m before cutover.

priya: SI quickstarts PR merged -> docs.redwood.com/si/partner-x.

legal-bot: HW-B approved 00:15 SGT. Asset pack uploaded to Drive.

marc: Great. Final reminder: deploy window blocked from 6329999800. Keep cutover before that. We'll use this thread for final signoff. :white_check_mark:
